description: [WRITE] Create a Snapchat Conversions API SERVER tag from the official template (Snapchat/capi-google-tag-manager-serverside-tag), imported automatically. pixelId is the Snap Pixel ID (public), apiAccessToken the CAPI token. `event` is the Snap event (PURCHASE, SIGN_UP, a GA4 name is mapped). eventId dedups against the Snap Pixel. User data and the default event_id are mapped from the Meta-style `ed - …` Event Data variables, which this tool creates in the workspace when they are missing. containerId must be the SERVER container. Needs a SERVER trigger (triggers_create) passed as firingTriggerId. Requires GTM_MCP_ENABLE_WRITES=true and confirm=true.

apiAccessToken.description: Snapchat CAPI access token, usually a {{variable}} so it is not stored in plain text on the tag.

confirm.description: Must be true to confirm this write operation.

containerId.description: The SERVER container ID (for the plan tool: the WEB container).

customData.description: Override rows {name, value}; names are the template's own field keys.

firingTriggerId.description: SERVER trigger id(s) the tag fires on (triggers_create, type customEvent). Usually one.

name.description: Tag name; defaults to "Snapchat CAPI Tag".

serverData.description: Override rows {name, value}; names are the template's own field keys.

userData.description: Override rows {name, value}; names are the template's own field keys.

name: create_snapchat_capi_server_tag
